svg.title: FreeEEG128 alpha: individual ST-Link and power pins
svg.desc: Same component-side mapping as FreeEEG32. Upper header J2 above BOOT: upper-left round pad pin 4 is 5 V, lower-left round pad pin 2 is ground. Lower header J1 below RESET: upper-left round pad pin 4 is PA13 SWDIO, upper-right round pad pin 3 is PA14 SWCLK, lower-left round pad pin 2 is NRST. Lower-right square pad pin 1 is PB2 BOOT1, unused. Detail rotates the original photograph 45 degrees counterclockwise and points to individual PCB pin bases.
svg.text: FreeEEG128 alpha · ST-Link and power connections
Same physical mapping as FreeEEG32 · Component-side view · Leaders end on individual metal pin bases
Find the two headers
J2 · Power, above BOOT
5 V and GND
J1 · SWD, below RESET
SWDIO, SWCLK and NRST
Supplied photograph. The enlarged view at right is rotated
45° so BOOT sits above RESET, as in the FreeEEG32 guide.
Actual pin bases · same layout as the 32
Use the signal labels on your ST-Link; probe connector layouts vary.
BOOT
RESET
J2 · above BOOT
J1 · below RESET
Round pad positions match FreeEEG32. J1's lower-right square
pad is PB2 / BOOT1 (pin 1): leave it unused.
ST-Link: SWDIO → PA13 · SWCLK → PA14 · STM32 NRST / RST → NRST · GND → GND
5 V is the board power input. Probe VTref/VAPP, if needed, goes to measured target 3.3 V; keep probe power outputs separate.
After first ST-Link installation: choose USB update, or double-RESET within 600 ms and copy the application UF2 to FREEEEG128.
BOOT selects ST ROM boot. Disconnect electrodes during programming. Pin numbers checked against this board's KiCAD PCB.
